## Checklist

- [ ] One Task ID; active lock and all changed paths are allowed
- [ ] Acceptance criteria pass and evidence is attached
- [ ] No unrelated feature/phase work
- [ ] No secret, token, PII, real customer data/document, or generated artifact
- [ ] API/schema/permission/state/environment changes have an approved Change Request
- [ ] Documentation and DECISIONS.md are updated where needed
- [ ] Required reviewers approved and conversations are resolved
- [ ] WORKFLOW_STATE.json and RESUME.md will match the merged commit
- [ ] Task is not BLOCKED; any waiver is explicit, approved and time-bounded
